subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the Collective of Plenty

80160101.text: Oh, "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini" and Paimon... Fancy that. I didn't expect to run into you two here.

80160102.text: Oh, hey! Coach Iansan! What are you doing here all by yourself?

80160103.text: Uh... Just so you know, Paimon didn't come here to train... Paimon's not looking to sign up for any diet plan or bodybuilding class right now.

80160104.text: Hahaha... Alright, got it. But seriously, what do you take me for? Some coach from hell? I'd never force a student into something they didn't wanna do.

80160105.text: That being said... A little aerobic exercise would probably do you some good. You could take over my patrol for a while, that would count...

80160108.text: Yeah, all jokes aside — you're right. I'm looking for some help.

80160109.text: The Collective of Plenty is holding a bodybuilding competition soon, and so many people have been busy squeezing in their last-minute workouts that we've run out of staff for patrols.

80160110.text: Oh, so you've stepped in to cover their work. But... don't you have a last-minute workout to do, too?

80160111.text: I'm good. For one thing, I believe peak conditioning can only be achieved through consistent training over a long timespan. Cramming in a workout at the last minute does next to nothing for you.

80160112.text: But more pertinently... Well, as you can probably imagine, I'm not able to compete in any of the most popular weight classes, and there's no real competition in my own weight class...

80160114.text: ...Ohh no, don't look at Paimon like that! We are not the same weight class, and no way is Paimon competing against you!

80160115.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's just help with the patrol, alright? Otherwise, Iansan's gonna make Paimon enter a bodybuilding competition...

80160116.text: Hahaha... Perfect, I managed to get you on board with just one look.

subQuests.subQuestName: Patrol the area near the Collective of Plenty
Check on the situation in the cave

80160201.text: Hey, there's a hilichurl here! Is it... sleeping? Doesn't look very hostile.

80160202.text: Why is it hiding away here?

80160204.text: Huh!? It ran away... Guess our reputation in Natlan is more fearsome than we thought. Even hilichurls don't wanna mess with us now.

80160206.text: You mean that shiny thing? Must've dropped it as it ran off.

80160207.text: Huh... Paimon bets that hilichurl thought it was a priceless treasure. It was probably planning to hide it here for safekeeping... until we showed up.

80160208.text: Let Paimon take a look! Hilichurls aren't the brightest, so it might not be worth much, but still...

80160210.text: #What is it, {NICKNAME}? You look so serious all of a sudden...

80160211.text: Isn't this just a regular old key? Hmm, the style is unusual, though. Doesn't look Natlanese... Where do you think it's from?

80160214.text: What do you mean? What hibernation chamber? What spaceship?

80160215.text: *gasp* Wait, you mean... THE spaceship? The one that brought you to Teyvat!?

80160217.text: So... how did that key show up here? Are you sure you didn't just drop it?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Speaker's Chamber to look for Mavuika

80160302.text: #Oh? Great timing, Iansan. I was just about to send someone for you. And it's good to see {NICKNAME}'s with you.

80160303.text: How are things looking? What's the latest word from the messengers?

80160304.text: The Abyss Order has been spotted near several tribes at the same time. Clearly, this is a coordinated strike.

80160305.text: Also, their numbers are much higher than expected. Their organization appears to have grown considerably, but because they're usually so secretive, this is the first we're learning of it.

80160306.text: It sounds like they're throwing everything they have at us... What are they trying to achieve?

80160307.text: That's what I'd like to know as well. Historically, Natlan has not been a hotbed of Abyss Order activity, and we have no particular quarrel with them.

80160308.text: Could it be... revenge, perhaps? Would they want to get back at us for our recent victory over the Abyss?

80160309.text: Seems unlikely... But then again, Paimon wouldn't put anything past the Abyss Order.

80160310.text: It's too early to say anything definite. For the time being, we should continue monitoring the situation.

80160311.text: How are the battles going? Not too many casualties, hopefully?

80160312.text: Well, even if they're committing all their forces to the fight, they're in for a tough time. Our brave warriors have just emerged victorious from an all-out fight against the Abyss itself.

80160313.text: Yep. We have a whole nation's worth of seasoned veterans fighting for us.

80160314.text: Compared to the true Abyss, the Abyss Order poses a far smaller threat. They cannot endlessly replenish their forces, for starters.

80160315.text: However, this is still a war, so we must give it our all, and do our utmost to minimize casualties.

80160316.text: #The tribes are organizing their defenses as we speak. {NICKNAME}, this is one war that Natlan can handle on its own. If you wish to stay out of it, you'll be safe here at the Stadium with me.

80160317.text: No, this one is personal for me...

80160322.text: I see... My goodness. That is... very personal indeed.

80160323.text: #If you don't mind me asking, do you have any idea what {M#her}{F#his} goal could be?

80160324.text: That's what I want to know as well.

80160325.text: Safe to say, they're not exactly on the best terms at the moment.

80160326.text: #Ever since Paimon met {NICKNAME}, {M#he}{F#she}'s been trying to track {M#his sister}{F#her brother} down and get some answers. But {M#she}{F#he}'s been avoiding {M#him}{F#her}.

80160327.text: I see. So you two have fallen out... Heh, a pretty common occurrence between siblings.

80160328.text: Well, yeah, that may be... But the stakes are a little higher where these two are involved!

80160329.text: #They certainly are... Although somehow, it doesn't surprise me that a spat between {NICKNAME} and twin could affect the fate of the entire world.

80160330.text: Just so I'm clear — you're still on Natlan's side, and you have no idea what your sibling is after. Is that right?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Masters of the Night-Wind to provide support

80160401.text: Phew... Much better. That's more like it!

80160402.text: Impressive work, Granny Itztli. If I'd known you were on the case already, I might have reconsidered whether your tribe really needed reinforcements.

80160403.text: Hah! If anyone should be reconsidering, it's the Abyss Order. They picked the wrong target this time!

80160404.text: Experience says that if we head in the direction they were attacking from, we should find their stronghold.

80160405.text: Why don't we press our advantage and destroy their base? They won't know what hit 'em.

80160406.text: Hey, was there a battle here just now? Need any help?

80160407.text: Ah, the warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind are here!

80160408.text: The battle against the Abyss is still fresh on our minds, so everyone's used to working together.

80160409.text: Well, morale's high and everyone's here. Let's go take down that stronghold!

80160502.text: Huh, I wasn't expecting to see you here. Are you here to reinforce us?

80160503.text: How are things looking? Mavuika told us to come here.

80160504.text: Huh... The situation must be pretty dire if it's managed to get Citlali out of the house...

80160505.text: Dire... No, I wouldn't go that far. It's mostly just... irritating.

80160506.text: I heard we're being hit the hardest out of all the tribes. What are they trying to imply? They just think we're pushovers, or something?

80160507.text: The more I thought about it, the angrier I got. I couldn't exactly concentrate on my novel after that, so... Hmph, well, here I am.

80160508.text: So that's how they earned the ire of Granny Itztli, huh...

80160509.text: They call themselves the "Abyss Order," yes? So tasteless. It's exactly the kind of two-dimensional name a clueless writer picks because they don't trust the rest of their writing to persuade the reader of who the real villains are...

80160510.text: #Hey, she's saying your {M#sister}{F#brother} has poor taste...

80160513.text: #Wait, what? Are you saying... {M#his sister}{F#her brother} is a member of the Abyss Order?

80160514.text: (I only said that because I was mad... but maybe I went too far?)

80160515.text: Hey, let's save the chat for later. We've got some enemies incoming.

80160516.text: Good! A much-needed chance to vent my frustration! And not a moment too soon — things were getting awkward there. Luckily, I'll never have to find out just how badly the rest of that conversation was gonna go.

80160517.text: You didn't have to say that last part out loud, Citlali... Anyway, let's get 'em!

subQuests.subQuestName: Launch a counterattack against the Abyss Order

80160701.text: This stronghold is neutralized. Good work, everyone.

80160702.text: Hmph, the Abyss Order's all bark and no bite.

80160703.text: To be honest, this was anticlimactic. I was hoping for a personal apology at the very least. And ideally, a whole speech acknowledging the superior might of the Masters of the Night-Wind...

80160704.text: Well, whatever. I'll just have to make up for it with some extra wine at the victory feast.

80160705.text: With the stronghold cleared, this area should be safe for the time being. But still... something tells me we can't afford to let our guard down yet.

80160706.text: Maybe it's just me, but an enemy under siege normally defends their stronghold at all costs. The fighting gets more and more intense, right till the bitter end.

80160707.text: But this time was different. With a few exceptions, most of the enemies here gave up and fled the moment that... Well, I don't know, but it seemed like they sensed something.

80160708.text: Huh? Not sure I follow... They did a tactical retreat, that's all. It's just a different strategy.

80160709.text: I'm not convinced... Don't forget, they're radicals who chose to wage war on an entire nation. They don't do things in half measures. It seems out-of-character to cut their losses and run like that.

80160710.text: So you're saying, there's more to this than meets the eye?

80160711.text: I'm saying we don't know enough to be sure of anything at this stage. So let's stay alert and keep our defenses at the ready.

80160712.text: (So, we're no wiser as to the Abyss Order's objective. Back to square one...)

80160713.text: #(If I could only get {M#Lumine}{F#Aether} to talk to me, I could get answers for all of us.)

80160716.text: Paimon had a hunch you might say that.

80160717.text: But you're right. If we can somehow use that key to track down your sibling, maybe we can end this war before things get serious. And maybe you can finally get some answers.

80160718.text: Wait, you're leaving? But I was still debating whether to invite you to the first victory feast...

80160719.text: Go ahead, you two. Citlali and I will take care of things here.

80161001.text: And don't worry, you're still Natlan's hero. I'm not going to blame you for something your sibling has done.

80161002.text: #Still, if we manage to find your {M#sister}{F#brother}... You wouldn't mind if I gave {M#her}{F#him} a good punch to teach {M#her}{F#him} a lesson, would you?

80169901.text: Hmm, what's this? Was there always a cave here?

80169902.text: We should go take a look, right? Seems like a thing to do on a patrol.
